title: 5 Proverbs a Godly Man Reads Before He Speaks in Anger
caption:
5 Proverbs a godly man reads before he speaks in anger.

Proverbs 15:1, 14:29, 29:11, 10:19, and 17:27. Not to win the argument, but to be the man who's still in charge of his mouth when it's over.

Screenshot this and put it somewhere you'll see it when your pulse is up.

theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
